regime_context: The Hong Kong detector shows a narrow leadership structure: Banks (H + HK) leads with the strongest breadth (0.769) and an eligible trend-gate, while only 4 of 17 themes are trend-eligible. No theme is crowded and no one-narrative is dominant; cross-sectional momentum rank is a focus lens only, with the only validated edge being the absolute-trend gate for drawdown avoidance (gate_helps: true). Backtest verdict confirms rotation-timing has no forward edge, so this desk note offers at most checkable, falsifiable conditional leans on the few trend-eligible themes.
emerging_watch: Watching whether the very narrow rotation breadth (only 4 of 17 themes eligible) expands before Banks or High-Dividend Blue Chips lose trend eligibility; if eligibility count drops below 3 while Banks still leads, the staying-power case for the current leader would be retired as a durable trend.

theses.subject: Banks (H + HK)
theses.thesis: Banks is the only theme that pairs the highest momentum rank with an eligible absolute-trend gate AND the strongest breadth (0.769), consistent with a durable trend-following, vol-aware allocation stance rather than a return forecast. Its mean-revert Hurst tag and higher crowding_z (0.77, not crowded) argue for treating it as an established leader to size down on, not chase. Backtest supports the gate as drawdown control, so the lean is toward maintaining exposure, not adding on momentum alone.
evidence: breadth 0.769 is the highest of all 17 themes
absolute_trend_gate is validated_risk_control for drawdown avoidance
theses.dissent: Hurst tag is mean-revert and this theme has no scorable ETF proxy, so it cannot be graded against a concrete price series and carries elevated unscheduled-news exposure (macro_narrative unscheduled_share = 1.0).

falsifier.text: An eligible proxy or the Hang Seng Financials sub-index closes below its 200-day average for five consecutive sessions before the 30-day check-by date.

check.reason: theme has no scalar etf_proxy → not cleanly scorable

theses.subject: High-Dividend Blue Chips
theses.thesis: This theme ranks third, is trend-eligible, and shows a trend-classified Hurst tag with 0.625 breadth and a near-zero crowding_z (-0.05) — the cleanest trend-health profile among scorable, non-crowded themes. The absolute-trend gate is the only validated risk-control leg, so a low-conviction overweight on a trend-eligible, uncrowded income theme is more consistent with the detector's discipline than a momentum chase.
evidence: gate_helps true supports vol-aware drawdown control
theses.dissent: No ETF proxy (scorable=false) makes the call ungradable, and the cross-sectional momentum rank has rank-IC ~0, so the third-place rank is a focus description, not an alpha signal.

falsifier.text: A listed HK dividend blue-chip basket lags the Hang Seng by 8% after accounting for dividends before the end of the 45-day horizon.

check.reason: theme has no scalar etf_proxy → not cleanly scorable

theses.subject: Tech Hardware & Semis
theses.thesis: Tech Hardware & Semis is trend-eligible (eligibility gate true) despite a low rank (9) and weak breadth (0.167). The idea is that the trend gate is the only validated leg, so names that pass it merit staying-power in a vol-aware framework even if they lack momentum rank. The positive crowding_z (0.25) is not a crowding flag, so no size-down caution applies.
theses.dissent: Breadth of only 0.167 is the second-lowest among eligible themes, and the weak momentum score (0.077) is consistent with a lack of focus flow; the call leans on only one leg (trend gate) with no momentum support.

falsifier.text: A representative Hong Kong-listed semiconductor or tech-hardware sub-index closes below its 63-day average for ten consecutive sessions within the 30-day horizon.

check.reason: theme has no scalar etf_proxy → not cleanly scorable

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
